name: Timer delivery retains timer row
description: A timer delivery refactor omits deleting the consumed timer, allowing repeated delivery.
expected_check: P3 timer uniqueness and consumed-row check

name: Inbox flush precedes command events
description: Workflow completion flushes buffered external events before recording its commands.
expected_check: activation ordering and replay history matching

name: Workflow token omits started event comparison
description: The workflow token validator drops its direct comparison with the task started event.
expected_check: workflow stale token rejection
equivalent_reason: The remaining run.LastEventID != tok.StartedEventId guard rejects every differing started ID on engine-reachable states: PollWorkflowTask writes TaskStarted last and stores that same ID in task.StartedEventID; while InFlight, external events only enter the inbox; complete, fail, and timeout clear or replace the task. This mutant removes a redundant guard only, assuming state was produced through the engine.

name: Activity retry does not increment attempt
description: An activity retry resets visibility and lease but forgets to increment the attempt fence.
expected_check: retry attempt progression or bounded scenario completion

name: Close retains buffered events
description: Run cleanup omits draining the unreachable inbox after a closing command.
expected_check: closed-run inbox emptiness

name: In-flight signal is acknowledged and dropped
description: An optimization mistakenly discards signals arriving while workflow work is leased.
expected_check: accepted-signal exactly-once delivery or scenario completion

name: Workflow task failure retains InFlight
description: SDK-error workflow task failure schedules a retry but leaves the old in-flight projection set.
expected_check: workflow task projection check after failure

name: Last event projection increments one too far
description: An inclusive-count mistake increments the run history projection one past the appended batch.
expected_check: P4 contiguous history and last_event_id projection

name: Heartbeat does not extend deadline
description: Heartbeat details are persisted but the heartbeat timestamp is not refreshed, causing premature expiry.
expected_check: heartbeat lease-extension check

name: Retry is queued past schedule-to-close
description: Retry eligibility ignores that the next visibility time is after the activity schedule-to-close deadline.
expected_check: activity retry deadline projection and final timeout semantics

name: Cancel-before-start retains deliverable activity
description: Cancelling an unleased activity emits ActivityCancelled but forgets to remove its queue task.
expected_check: cancelled activity has no deliverable task

name: Continuation uses predecessor input
description: A copied run initializer uses the old input instead of the ContinueAsNew command input.
expected_check: continuation expected result or bounded scenario completion

name: Human approval may resolve twice
description: The human approval endpoint omits its pending-state fence and accepts repeated decisions.
expected_check: duplicate approval rejection and one resolution event

name: Timer deletion commits before delivery
description: A transaction-scope refactor commits DeleteTimer separately before its event delivery; failure or a competing actor can observe the gap.
expected_check: P3 pending timer row or buffered delivery consistency

name: ClaimTask ignores an active lease
description: Queue selection drops the unleased filter and can hand the same live task to another worker.
expected_check: exclusive task claim and workflow token fencing

name: Expired workflow completion is accepted
description: Workflow token validation relies only on the asynchronous reaper and accepts an expired token before it runs.
expected_check: late workflow acknowledgement rejection

name: Expired activity completion is accepted
description: Activity token validation omits the start-to-close lease check and accepts a stale completion before the reaper.
expected_check: late activity acknowledgement rejection

name: Transaction snapshot aliases mutable tasks
description: A snapshot optimization shares the task map across transactions, so rollback leaks task mutations.
expected_check: transaction rollback snapshot equality and task/history consistency

name: Inbox push prepends instead of appending
description: Buffered external events use stack insertion instead of FIFO order.
expected_check: accepted signal order and workflow result

name: Timer selection includes a future millisecond
description: A boundary adjustment widens the due-timer predicate by one millisecond.
expected_check: P3 no early timer delivery and early sweep count

name: Timer row references the completing task event
description: Timer insertion stores the workflow completion event ID where the timer-start event ID belongs.
expected_check: P3 timer started-event reference

name: Effect idempotency key omits run identity
description: An idempotency-key refactor uses one shared prefix, causing unrelated runs with the same sequence to share effects.
expected_check: P1 effect keys and concurrent run expected results

name: Gate decision arriving after deadline wins
description: Gate response handling does not recheck the deadline after external I/O.
expected_check: approval deadline expected outcome

name: Gate pending status is treated as approval
description: An external-status mapping mistakenly treats PENDING as a successful approval.
expected_check: Gate pending must not resolve approval

name: Gate error becomes a final denial
description: Transient Gate failures are converted to permanent denial instead of remaining pending for retry.
expected_check: Gate error retry and expected outcome

name: RunTasks leaks other runs task rows
description: A missing run predicate returns every task; closing one run deletes work belonging to concurrent runs.
expected_check: per-run task ownership and concurrent completion
